description: This file defines the PersistableCategory class, which extends CategoryEntity and implements Serializable. It adds properties for descriptions and parent category, including getters and setters.

classes.name: PersistableCategory
classes.description: A class representing a category that can be persisted, extending CategoryEntity and serializable, with additional description and parent category properties.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the category.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the category.
